$Comment: Percent bonus to Physical damage the carrier deals, in whole percent points (10 is +10%). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat; ziggfreed-common adds it to every hit whose damage cause is Physical or filed under it (Bludgeoning, Slashing, Crush, and a mod's own Physical types), after the hit's other bonuses. Projectile hits have their own pair, DamageBonus_Projectile. Base 0, so an unmodified entity deals ordinary damage; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
